name: Sei Chishiki no Nai Imouto ni, Ofuro Ecchi o Oshiete Mita Kekka...
original_name: 性知識のない妹に、お風呂エッチを教えてみた結果…
source:
As we have gone through a lot of sex, my younger sister 
Kurumi recently comes to my room after our parents go to bed.

We are now in a relationship just like lovers. This time in the absence 
of our parents having a trip, we have an all-day sex spree together!
